page.overview:
Who is Darrin?

Darrin, aka Uncle Dare, is a major character in Fetch, the first story of the Fazbear Frights 2: Fetch. He's Greg's flamboyant and rich uncle who he enjoys spending time with much more than his parents.

Dare is six-foot-five with broad shoulders. He also has a huge head, a graying goatee, and long hair that's dyed purple and worn in a braid. Dare tends to wear bright-colored suits and ties paired with patterned shirts, and on his right index finger is an onyx and gold ring.

Dare is flamboyant and fun, even when it comes to food. He loves and cares for his family, even if his brother-in-law doesn't respect or care for him back. Dare is especially close to Greg and is very accepting of him, not caring for his likes and dislikes.

Darrin is a wealthy, successful inventor of car parts. This mixed with his incredible luck with investments and money in general allows him to live on a ten-acre estate with a workshop. This put him at odds with his brother-in-law, Steven, who he constantly fought with. Dare still deeply cared for his only sibling, Hillary, and this love extended onto Greg when he was born. Dare would be incredibly supportive of Greg's interests, make him gifts, and teach him things, such as yoga.
